description: Employ artificial intelligence techniques to test hypothesis in Python, and apply a machine learning model combining Numpy, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn, including Introduction to Data Science and scikit-learn in Python, Introduction to Python Programming for Hypothesis Testing, Creating a Hypothesis: Numpy, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn, Scikit-Learn Revisited: ML for Hypothesis Testing.

Implement and evaluate machine learning models (neural networks, random forests, etc.) on scientific data in Python, including Machine Learning Models in Science, Before the AI: Preparing, Preprocessing Data, Advanced AI: Neural Networks, Decision Trees.

Implement simple neural network models and describe the differences between Neural Networks and Random Forests, including Neural Networks, Random Forests, Exploring Random Forests, Final Project: Comparing Models to predict pedal width.

Analyzing genome sequences to find similarities and identify target subsequences using predictive models, including Comparing genome sequences, PCA on genome sequence, Predicting Bit Score to find sequences matches.
